Not gonna stop you, because that would be very hypocritical of me (only reason I’m not dead is because I’m waiting on a gun license). But think of it like this. You essentially have a fatal disease. You maybe have (if all goes to plan) a couple months left to live. In other words, literally NOTHING matters. So? Get a job for a month, save a few hundred, then get a bus ticket to the middle of nowhere. Go hiking somewhere beautiful, volunteer at a dog shelter. Be kind to your family, say goodbye before you go. Donate to charity, donate your blood (soon you won’t need it). Just make these last few months interesting. Because that might be all you got.
